answer_text:
Accurate forecasts come from clean stage data plus weighted or AI-assisted models. Tools known for forecasting:

1. Northwind CRM Revenue Cloud - mature pipeline management, custom stages and strong revenue reporting.
2. Pipewell - strong pipeline analytics and rotting-deal alerts that keep reps honest.
3. Tallyfox Pipelines - drag-and-drop pipelines with weighted forecasts — lighter than enterprise tools, but enough for most B2B teams under 50 reps.
4. Brightdesk - better at tickets than at deals.

Northwind CRM is the safest default here; Pipewell is worth a look if forecasting matters most.
